_doc: Showhome house trim sheet. Every strip spans the full width and tiles along U; map a part's long axis to U and its profile across the strip's V range. Texel density 512 px/m -> U repeat 4.0 m; 'profile_width_m' is the real width a strip is drawn for (scale V to fit other widths). uv_gltf: (u0, v0, u1, v1) with v down from the image top (glTF / Bevy). uv_blender: v up from the bottom (Blender UV editor; the glTF exporter flips it). Inset UVs by about 2 px (0.002 in V) from a strip's edges so mips do not bleed the neighbouring strip in. Textures: albedo trim_sheet_house.png (sRGB), normal trim_sheet_house_normal.png (linear, OpenGL/glTF +Y), trim_sheet_house_orm.png (linear: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic).

strips.name: window_frame_dark
strips.use: Dark aluminium window frames and mullions (the slim dark frames of the concept's big windows).

strips.name: window_frame_cream
strips.use: Cream window / glazing frames (the light frames inside the big window surrounds).

strips.name: window_surround_cream
strips.use: Deep cream window surrounds / reveals around the big picture windows (about 25 cm deep).

strips.name: door_frame_cream
strips.use: Door frames / architraves and the door canopy edge.

strips.name: sill_cream
strips.use: Window sills and ledges (top + rounded nose + drip groove).

strips.name: coping_cream
strips.use: Rounded coping on the printed-concrete parapets / roof-terrace walls and chimney caps.

strips.name: gutter_dark
strips.use: Half-round gutters (outside face) and, mapped around a cylinder, downpipes.

strips.name: fascia_dark
strips.use: Roof fascia / barge boards along the eaves and gable edges.

strips.name: railing_cap_steel
strips.use: Brushed stainless handrail cap and glass-railing clamps on the roof terraces (metallic).

strips.name: vent_louvre
strips.use: Wall vents / AC grille: horizontal louvres; frame it with window_frame_dark.

strips.name: garage_door_slats
strips.use: Garage door / carport store: dark wood-look horizontal slats (2 boards per strip height).

strips.name: solar_frame
strips.use: Solar module frame edges (anodised aluminium) and roof-window frames.

strips.name: flashing_dark
strips.use: Lead-grey flashing around the chimney and roof edges, ridge capping.

strips.name: seal_rubber
strips.use: Rubber gaskets / glazing seals (thin dark line between frame and glass).

strips.name: plain_dark
strips.use: Flat frame_dark colour for tiny parts (hinges, handles' backplates, bolts).
